text: SkyCity Entertainment Group's shares are quoted on the NZX Main Board and the ASX. Its 2026 annual report lists three substantial product holders as at 30 June 2026: Allan Gray Group (12.55%), Accident Compensation Corporation (11.84%) and AustralianSuper Pty Ltd (8.32%).
short: SkyCity is listed; its substantial holders are Allan Gray, ACC and AustralianSuper.
